'''bounty hunter6 fun-weapons deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 24 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Strike Team
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 RST hunter6 LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Shoot down your opponent...just for fun...

== Strategy ==

shoot down your opponent...you can fire your whole reserve deck at them...with 10 sevens packed...superfical damage will take care of attrition and crack shot will make them lose alot...not the greatest deck in the world...just an idea I came up with...
